title: BaseLocalizationCohomologyIsIso
statement: For commutative rings R, Rp, A, B, D with R to Rp a localization at S, compatible R and Rp algebra structures on A and B, tensor coefficient maps to D, and derived categories, let Q be any A-cochain complex and L, K the base-derived tensor cohomology models over R and Rp. In every degree i the canonical B-linear baseLocalizationCohomologyMap of [lem-pc-base-localization-map] is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition, affine displayed localization identity; More on Algebra Tag 06Y6

proof.text:
choose a K-flat Rp-resolution P of the restricted input Q. Restriction to R
preserves K-flatness: tensor an acyclic R-complex with Rp, use exactness of localization,
and identify its tensor with P by associativity. Apply the K-flat counit theorem to
both universal derived functors on P. The counit equation for the universal lift,
and the ordinary localization tensor isomorphism, then make the lift on P invertible.
The augmentation P to Q is a quasi-isomorphism over both bases; naturality transports
invertibility to Q. Apply the B-homology functor and conjugate by the two model
cohomology isomorphisms. This is exactly baseLocalizationCohomologyMap. Identity
localization gives model transport; when S contains zero, both cohomologies are zero.
No algebra structures on D over A or B, and no flatness of D, are needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJ8 affine localization identity; Tag 06Y6 universal counit and localization tensor identity
